hierarchy_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-light-text font-display
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-light-text font-display

layouts.app_shell: Flex container with fixed left navigation and a flex-1 scrolling right content area.

items.default: text-dark-muted hover:text-dark-text hover:bg-dark-surface px-4 py-2 rounded-[3px] transition-colors duration-200
items.active: text-dark-text bg-dark-surface relative before:absolute before:left-0 before:top-0 before:h-full before:w-[3px] before:bg-primary-base before:rounded-r-[3px]

sidebar.sections: Logo/Workspace top, Nav items middle, Profile/Logout fixed at bottom border-t border-dark-border

content_view.depth_strategy: To prevent light data-dense screens from looking flat, use light.surface (#F2F0EB) for cards/kanban columns, accompanied by a 1px solid light.border (#E5E2DC). Cards on kanban boards should have a pure white background (#FFFFFF) with shadow-sm to lift them off the #F2F0EB column.

ai_copilot.trigger: Fixed position bottom-8 right-8. Circular button, w-14 h-14, bg-primary-base hover:bg-primary-hover text-white shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center rounded-full z-40 transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95.
ai_copilot.panel: Fixed top-0 right-0 h-screen w-[380px] sm:w-[400px] z-50 bg-[#FFFFFF] border-l border-light-border shadow-ai_copilot transform transition-transform duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)] flex flex-col.
ai_copilot.header: h-16 border-b border-light-border flex items-center justify-between px-6 bg-[#FFFFFF]
ai_copilot.differentiation: The AI layer uses crisp pure #FFFFFF and a slightly warmer #FCFBF9 for chat background, distinguishing it from the main app's #F9F8F6 base. It feels elevated via prominent drop shadows and z-index.

motion.rule: NO transition-all. Use specific transitions only.

kanban.column: bg-light-surface rounded-[3px] p-3 border border-light-border flex flex-col gap-3 min-w-[300px]
kanban.card: bg-white p-4 rounded-[3px] border border-light-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex flex-col gap-2 relative
kanban.card_score: text-xs font-mono px-2 py-1 bg-light-surface rounded-[3px] text-light-muted self-start

data_table.header: bg-light-surface border-b border-light-border text-xs font-mono text-light-muted uppercase py-3 px-4 text-left

chat_bubble.user: bg-light-surface text-light-text rounded-[3px] rounded-tr-none p-3 max-w-[85%] self-end text-sm
chat_bubble.ai: bg-white border border-light-border text-light-text rounded-[3px] rounded-tl-none p-3 max-w-[85%] self-start text-sm shadow-sm

icons_assets.rules: No emoji icons. Use clean, monoline lucide icons with stroke-width 1.5 or 2.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-light-text against light-bg and text-dark-text against dark-bg meet WCAG AA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve the 'SalesMind' warm monochrome + coral identity.
Implement the global layout shell with a fixed dark sidebar (#1A1918) and a light scrolling right-hand content area (#F9F8F6).
Convert all previously dark views (Dashboard, Deals, Contacts, Sequences) to use the light palette. Use layering (white cards on #F2F0EB surfaces) to prevent flatness.
Implement the AI Co-pilot as a global fixed component at the App/Layout level, not tied to a specific route. Use a floating trigger button at bottom-right.
Extend Tailwind config to include the specific custom colors (e.g., primary-base, light-bg, dark-surface) and font families (IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Apply sharp 3px border radius (`rounded-[3px]`) universally to cards, buttons, inputs, and sidebars.
Do NOT use `.tsx` files; implement React components in `.js` or `.jsx` format as per standard.
Avoid `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`, or `transition-opacity`.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (e.g., pure white cards on off-white surfaces).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align for better readability.
Always use modern button styles (sharp 3px radius for this system) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.
